name: SK Discovery Co., Ltd.
summary: SK Discovery Co., Ltd., a holding company, engages in environmental friendly materials, vaccines/pharmaceuticals, energy/chemicals, and real estate development businesses in South Korea and internationally. The company provides environmental friendly materials and healthcare solutions in the areas of treatment, prevention, and diagnosis to patients. It engages in the storage of LPG; tank terminal; and power generation business, as well as real estate development of commercial facilities, office buildings, hotels, urban housings, luxury housings, and renewable energy generation facilities, such as solar and wind power generation.
